recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5263 unless PA later reopens the Patient.contact versus RelatedPerson boundary.
issue_request: FHIR-5263 was a Published FHIR-core RelatedPerson ballot issue with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking to remove wording that implied Patient.contact should be used instead of RelatedPerson, and to state that some individuals may serve as both a Patient's Contact and a Related Person.
initial_application: The request was explicitly applied by commit 0205e036d4b18587f5b89829b458d61586308807, which changed source/relatedperson/relatedperson-introduction.xml from the old 'instead' wording to the approved two-sentence clarification.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists relatedperson as an active resource, so the RelatedPerson introduction is in current build scope. Later Published RelatedPerson issues FHIR-25727 and FHIR-30313 addressed broader scope/definition questions and did not supersede the contact-overlap sentence; both are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source says to use Patient.contact for contact purposes and that some individuals may serve as both a Patient's Contact and a Related Person, satisfying the Jira resolution.

related_jiras.note: Later Published RelatedPerson scope clarification quoted the same contact-overlap paragraph and did not supersede the FHIR-5263 wording; it is already audited on the combined branch.

Later Published issue broadened the RelatedPerson definition to include involvement in a patient's health, while leaving the contact-overlap guidance intact; it is already audited on the combined branch.
